seed_namespace.derivation: SHA256(seed/namespace/layer1 or layer2), first 8 bytes big endian modulo 2^63

numerical_entry.scope: same weights/features promoted to FP64 and full model rerun; empirical resolution proxy, not a certified error bound

full_valid_reference.tie_policy: average rank of exactly equal computed scores; target excluded from competitors

view.root_definition: zero indegree with descendants; largest distinct descendant count; ID tie-break
view.depth_scope: truncated H_dev reference-root paths, not full taxonomy depth

config.scope: E2 original section 11 development calibration; no confirmation, N1, E3 or retraining

selection.rule: first maximum complete valid micro MRR in immutable bounded baseline record

label_scope: train+valid only; test entity IDs are public split membership, not test relation labels
precision: FP32 native, same weights/features rerun FP64; no AMP or TF32
